d: Namaste, BMW India recently unveiled the X1 in a long-wheelbase version. The Petrol X1 on sale in India to date will be replaced by this LWB X1, and the Diesel will continue to come in standard Wheelbase. With this, the iX1 and X1 Petrol are now among the longest cars in the segment. I got the chance to drive the X1 Petrol, and here are my impressions.
